create_LogGpuMemoryHook: create a ClassyHook that prints GPU memory summary at specified training stages like forward, backward, and update
create_DumpMemoryOnException: create a ClassyHook that dumps all PyTorch tensors in memory to a file when an exception occurs during training
create_LogGpuStatsHook: create a ClassyHook that logs NVIDIA nvidia-smi GPU stats at the start of training and after 50 iterations
create_LogLossLrEtaHook: create a ClassyHook that logs training loss, learning rate, ETA, and batch time to stdout.json after each parameter update
create_LogLossMetricsCheckpointHook: create a ClassyHook that checks for NaN outputs, checkpoints models on failure, and saves metrics at phase end
